entries.resolution: The observed source currently has three built-in guard declarations and no production or persisted third-party extension requirement; its current registry still warns and skips an undeclared type, which is the defect being replaced. The target configuration path must reject an undeclared guard reference atomically as GuardConfigFailure.UnknownRuleType before controlled-effect admission. This is a current composition/availability fact, not a universal closed provider SDK: public data capabilities and provider effect trees remain declaration-specific and open. If independent evidence later establishes a shipped extension, add a separately versioned composition-root RuleDeclaration/Layer with its config, rule input/required facts/pass-fact/issue schemas, effect applicability, and implementation identity; preserve the exact provider leaf input/result/error schemas, bind the immutable snapshot fingerprint to new controlled-effect plans, and retain existing plans or require explicit reprepare. Never restore the untyped process-global registry.
